newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper extends losses, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper extends losses, other metals steady.

text.p: Copper prices extended losses, while other base metals remained steady in narrow ranges on the local market, dealers said on Thursday.
Copper moved down 25 rupees, for the second day in a row, to 13,475 rupees per quintal amid sluggish industrial demand, with losses in the world market prompting fresh selling.
Nickel was steady at 33,200 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees on Wednesday, while zinc consolidated at 8,300 rupees per quintal after gaining 50 on Wednesday.
Aluminium was indicated at its previous level of 7,700 rupees, as were lead at 4,150 rupees and tin at 28,500 rupees.
